name: NPC_Dialogue_System
description: NPC conversation system with cultural context, universal translator, reputation-gated dialogue, and educational content delivery through natural interaction.

questions.question: How does information gained through NPC dialogue (trade routes, hidden resources, repair services, market rumors) function as economically valuable knowledge that can be acted upon for profit?
questions.answer: Dialogue is the primary channel for economic intelligence. NPC gossip about a collapsed ridge exposing a new iron vein reveals a supply shock to exploit. A bar rumor about the refinery overpaying for copper is an arbitrage opportunity. A player who chats regularly gains 2-3 actionable tips per session, worth 50-200 credits each — a ~15% income differential over non-talkative players.

questions.question: Does NPC dialogue reveal the world's history through personal stories — a trader's tale of the route they traveled, a scientist's theory about the canyon's formation, a survivor's account of a storm?
questions.answer: Dialogue is the world's oral history: every NPC carries a fragment of the planet's story. The prospector knows where to find water, the scientist knows what the strata mean, the hermit knows what happened to the last settlement.

questions.question: Does dialogue feel natural to navigate -- can the player select responses, skip already-read text, and exit conversations at any point without friction or animation lock?
questions.answer: Dialogue uses a radial response menu (4 options max). Already-read text auto-skips on replay. Player can press Escape at any time to exit -- no forced animation playout. Response timer auto-selects default after 30s of inactivity.

questions.question: Does the dialogue state (active branch, completed topics, reputation-gated unlocks, conversation history) need to persist?
questions.answer: Yes. Dialogue state is complex: completed topics (bitmask or set of IDs), current reputation thresholds met, active quest dialogue branches. Written on conversation end or manual save.

questions.question: What physical principles apply to a dialogue system — is there any physics consideration (acoustic propagation, lip-sync physics, spatial audio)?
questions.answer: No physics relevance for the dialogue logic itself. Spatial audio and lip-sync are handled by UE5's audio and animation systems, not by the dialogue state machine.
